# Satellite Inference

> Satellite Inference is developing AI computing capacity in orbit: spacecraft inference software on a space-rated flight computer first, then solar-powered compute nodes. It is a development-stage program. Dates, volumes and prices are plans.

## Reserve capacity

- [How to reserve capacity](https://satelliteinference.com/reserve.md): what can be reserved, who can reserve, what binds, and how to prepare a request
- [Capacity plan and indicative prices](https://satelliteinference.com/data/capacity-offer.v8.json): JSON
- [Reservation request fields](https://satelliteinference.com/data/reservation-request.schema.json): JSON Schema
- [Reservation page](https://satelliteinference.com/reserve)
